frozen_at: 2026-09-28, before any HRL80 retarget / 4-group result exists
pipeline: HRL80 goes through the IDENTICAL frozen pipeline as old259 (r30 mode v1/v2-K/v2-Kr, tr mode, hybrid_merge); no change to threshold, K, lambda, window count, retrieval rule, gates

order.1_utility: per-segment TR usable rate vs old259 689/1229 = 56.1%; Kr_fallback and none rates; failure reasons no_workspace_window vs no_feasible_rollout vs old259 (none:no_workspace_window 399/1229)

order.2_posture: TR segments: held-out R120 NN p50/p90 (old259 TR 0.27/0.45 rad), k-means cluster coverage, start-posture diversity

order.3_dynamics: TR segments: |dq| p95, W1 |dq| and W1 |ddq| vs R30 and vs held-out R120, HRL80 TR vs old259 TR

order.4_transfer: old259 live -> offline vs HRL80 live -> offline (robotlike_compare_groups.py 4-group table)

definitions.start_posture_diversity: q(0) of every TR segment; (a) distinct R120 k-means clusters (same clustering as v2k_compare cluster coverage) hit by starts, (b) NN of starts to held-out R120 p50/p90, (c) mean pairwise 12-D distance of starts. Because counts depend on N, old259 is also reported on 20 random subsamples of size N_HRL80_TR (numpy seed 0..19), median and range
definitions.size_matching: cluster coverage and start diversity are reported both raw and N-matched as above; NN / W1 / rates are N-independent and reported raw
definitions.transfer: see amendment_1 (T0 exact reproduction of the -0.009 reference, T1 primary = TR-usable fraction U_e)
definitions.hrl80_val: all HRL80 numbers on all 60 episodes; train/val split is not used for these descriptive metrics

readings_stated_in_advance.strong: TR usable clearly above 56.1% (e.g. 70-80%) with posture NN p50/p90 near 0.27/0.45 and dynamics equal or closer to real => a robot-compatible collection protocol increases usable robot-space trajectories, not only the retarget algorithm
readings_stated_in_advance.utility_up_posture_down: many more segments usable but NN clearly worse => rescued segments sit farther from the robot manifold
readings_stated_in_advance.live_up_offline_flat: live robot-like metrics improve but TR usable does not => live metrics (e.g. rotation speed) are not the cause of retarget feasibility; reinforces the old259 Spearman -0.009 finding; workspace remains the main failure

caveat: HRL80 is one collector, one session day, 6 tasks x 14; old259 differs in session / scene as well as protocol, so a difference is protocol + session, not protocol alone

amendment_1.at: 2026-09-28 18:01, still BEFORE any HRL80 retarget / offline / 4-group result exists
amendment_1.why: the transfer definition cited -0.009 as if it were a TR-usable correlation; it is not. Clarified, no new metric picked from results.
amendment_1.reference_minus_0.009_exact: x = max(left,right) live over_frac_ang_w (rotation-speed over-p95 fraction); y_e = fraction of the episode's baseline_offline segments with first_fail is None (v1 single-anchor robotlike_offline_check full pass); episodes with >= 1 segment (n 259); rank corr = Pearson of argsort-argsort ranks (ties NOT averaged). Reproduced for HRL80 with this exact code as T0.
amendment_1.T1_primary_transfer: U_e = (# segments of episode e with retarget_method == 'TR' in the master) / (# candidate segments of e = master segments that carry a v1 record, the same denominator as old259's 1229). NOT binary any-usable. x = the same live over_frac_ang_w. Spearman with average-rank ties (scipy.stats.spearmanr), episodes with >= 1 candidate segment; old259, HRL80, pooled.
amendment_1.T1_secondary_x: live over_frac_ang_a (rotation acceleration) and grasps_total, same U_e, reported but not used for the headline reading
amendment_1.size_matched_reading: for cluster coverage and start-posture diversity, HRL80 is read by its position inside the N-matched old259 subsample distribution (median, min-max over seeds 0..19), never against raw full old259
amendment_1.claim_wording: any improvement is reported as 'associated with the new collection protocol/session', not as a causal protocol effect (non-randomized: collector, day, scene differ); causal claim would need interleaved old/new protocol collection in one session
